finding.title: An ARIA-disabled control may validly reject or immediately release focus
finding.location: observe.mjs disabledCanFocus=false branch, final assert element.matches(:disabled)
finding.observedSource: When focus() does not leave the action active, the oracle requires native :disabled even though the prior disabled predicate explicitly admits native disabled OR aria-disabled=true.
finding.expected: The common support contract allows either disabled representation and does not require an ARIA-disabled action to retain focus. Legitimate immediate blur or focus retirement must not cause rejection solely for lacking native :disabled.
finding.impact: False rejection of a conforming common-scope control; representation-specific bias against one permitted disabled implementation.
finding.proposedCorrection: After an unsuccessful focus attempt, re-read native disabled and aria-disabled states and require at least one still true. Record native/ARIA representation and keyboard-not-dispatched/focus-rejected. Do not inject synthetic keyboard events and do not count Enter/Space as attempted or passed in this branch. Keep actual keyboard gesture checks for controls that retain focus.
finding.validation: Retain the first false rejection; calibrate both native and ARIA focus-rejecting positive controls plus the focus-retaining ARIA control and targeted disabled keyboard leakage mutation.
finding.reviewerAcknowledgment: The initial source review missed this valid ARIA focus-retirement branch. Its source-adequate disposition is withdrawn by this addendum; earlier ORACLE-01/02/03 source corrections remain accepted.

calibrationEvidence.report: Owner reports generated-existing failed this branch and a native positive control passed. No paths or browser results were inspected by this reviewer before this addendum. The finding is independently supported by the reviewed source and declared common support scope.

nextStep: Owner fixes the representation-specific rejection, preserves all initial calibration output, reruns affected actual browser calibration and supplies source/result hashes for follow-up review.
